title: feat: Support extract variable in macro call

target.summary: When extracting an expression from inside a macro call, the extracted variable's initializer is built from the macro-expanded syntax tree rather than the original source tokens. This discards original whitespace and comments, altering user formatting and producing invalid Rust code when adjacent tokens require whitespace (such as `&mutbar` or `iftrue`).
notes: faulty statement returning macro-expanded analysis expression without preserving source expression for the initializer
variable initializer expression is initialized by cloning the macro-expanded analysis expression
